elements.text: 9:41 Privacy policy In short: no accounts, and the game itself collects no data. The game Line Siege works offline. There are no accounts and no sign-in. Your progress, statistics and settings are stored only on this phone, and the game itself sends nothing anywhere. Ads Unless you have Premium, the game shows ads from Google AdMob. When an ad loads, Google may collect data such as device identifiers, approximate location and how you interact with ads, as described in Google’s own privacy policy. Where the law requires it, you are asked first. You can change your choice any time in Settings. Purchase Premium is bought through the App Store or Google Play. Apple or Google handles the payment; the game never sees your payment details. Phone backups Your phone’s own backup (iCloud or Google) may include your progress. That is your phone’s feature; the game receives nothing. Questions Write to support@example.com. Last updated 27 Sep 2026
